LESSON: BELIEF IN HIS

Grade: PP1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Belief in His

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Belief in His. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. narrate confidently simple through digital educational short stories on prophet materials

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. narrate confidently simple through digital educational short stories on prophet materials
   In simple words: practise until you can narrate confidently simple through digital educational short stories on prophet materials. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Belief in His using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Belief in His in the examples.
2. Explain Belief in His to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Belief in His.
4. Show that you can: narrate confidently simple through digital educational short stories on prophet materials

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Belief in His using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Belief in His important for a PP1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Role play on Prophet Muhammad’s character (Al Amin – the trustworthy).

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. narrate confidently simple through digital educational short stories on prophet materials

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
